items.title: Migrate decision-doc quorum trigger to unified review escalation policy
items.context: Migrate the hard DONE policy from direct decision-doc file-change quorum to a unified review-escalation predicate. Keep decision-doc change detection for diagnostics, add first-review countable-problem evaluation, and make machine DONE consume the new policy rather than blocking every documentation edit. Include host verdict identity/binding fields needed by the quorum predicate.

items.title: Add or update smoke coverage for documentation audit trigger cases
items.context: Prove zero-finding decision-doc changes do not require 3x2 after migration, first-review threshold findings still require quorum, degraded 3x1 behaves as lower assurance, and old hostId-only verdict handling does not regress existing quorum diagnostics.

items.title: Update operator-facing diagnostics and docs to avoid false always-on claims
items.context: Ensure decision_doc_quorum_check, review_escalation_status, and DONE gate messages describe documentation-audit classification, first-review escalation triggers, degraded-single-host assurance, and current Authority boundaries without claiming every decision-doc edit still requires 3x2.

items.title: Register review-escalation quorum facts in the process-fact contract
items.context: Because this story changes DONE-gate consumed facts, update process-fact registry, process-fact levels, command policy, CLI surface checks, and the process-fact contract verifier so docs, handlers, and gates cannot drift silently.
items.userSees: User sees process-fact verification pass for the new review-escalation quorum commands and gate facts.

items.title: Implement explicit degraded 3x1 review-escalation fallback
items.context: Add runtime support for approved degraded single-host review only when fallback eligibility, allowed reason, evidence or approval, fresh material binding, and lower-assurance reporting are present. It must never be reported as full 3x2 or Authority receipt completion.
items.userSees: User sees degraded 3x1 reported as degraded-single-host, not full 3x2, when policy permits it.
